teaser.en: A named but still unidentified Digo mushroom, one of several whose names carry a 'female' prefix.
teaser.sw: Uyoga wa Kidigo wenye jina lakini bado haujatambuliwa, mmoja wa kadhaa ambao majina yao yana kiambishi cha 'kike'.

summary.en: Nimahembo is a mushroom known to Digo collectors that has not yet been scientifically identified. Pakia notes its name among those with a prefix carrying a 'female' sense.
summary.sw: Nimahembo ni uyoga unaojulikana na wakusanyaji wa Kidigo ambao bado haujatambuliwa kisayansi. Pakia analitaja jina lake miongoni mwa yale yenye kiambishi kinachobeba maana ya 'kike'.

about.en: *Nimahembo* is a mushroom that Digo collectors know by name but that has not yet been scientifically identified. Pakia notes that some of the mushrooms he collected were still awaiting identification when his study was written. Digo collectors tell mushrooms apart mainly by the colour of the cap, but no description of *nimahembo* is recorded.
about.sw: *nimahembo* ni uyoga ambao wakusanyaji wa Kidigo wanaujua kwa jina lakini bado haujatambuliwa kisayansi. Pakia anaeleza kuwa baadhi ya uyoga aliokusanya ulikuwa bado unasubiri kutambuliwa wakati utafiti wake ulipoandikwa. Wakusanyaji wa Kidigo hutofautisha uyoga hasa kwa rangi ya kofia, lakini hakuna maelezo ya *nimahembo* yaliyorekodiwa.

where.en: Digo mushroom collectors recognise three mushroom grounds: *Brachystegia* woodland (*mirihini*), farmland (*mdani*) and termite mounds (*tsuluni*). Which of these this mushroom favours is not recorded.
where.sw: Wakusanyaji wa uyoga wa Kidigo wanatambua maeneo matatu ya uyoga: msitu wa *Brachystegia* (*mirihini*), mashamba (*mdani*) na vichuguu (*tsuluni*). Haijarekodiwa ni lipi kati ya haya ambalo uyoga huu hupendelea.

uses.en: Pakia notes that the Digo give names only to mushrooms they know as edible, so *nimahembo* is very likely one that local people collect and eat. Wild mushrooms should only be eaten when identified by someone with expert local knowledge.
uses.sw: Pakia anaeleza kuwa Wadigo huipa majina uyoga tu wanaoujua kuwa unalika, kwa hiyo huenda sana *nimahembo* ni mmoja wa uyoga ambao wenyeji hukusanya na kula. Uyoga wa porini unapaswa kuliwa tu ukiwa umetambuliwa na mtu mwenye ujuzi wa kina wa kienyeji.

culture.en: Pakia notes that several Digo mushroom names, *nkuvi*, *nimaziya*, *nimakoba* and *nimahembo*, begin with a prefix that in personal names marks a woman. Digo has no grammatical gender, so this seems to be a borrowed sense rather than a grammar rule. Mushroom collecting is women's work among the Digo. Pakia found that only about ten kinds, those learnt from the elders as edible, are eaten, and that collectors pick them young, with the cap still closed (*fundula*), because open caps (*bumula*) are usually full of worms.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza kuwa majina kadhaa ya uyoga ya Kidigo, *nkuvi*, *nimaziya*, *nimakoba* na *nimahembo*, huanza kwa kiambishi ambacho katika majina ya watu huashiria mwanamke. Kidigo hakina jinsia ya kisarufi, kwa hiyo hii inaonekana kuwa maana iliyoazimwa badala ya kanuni ya kisarufi. Kukusanya uyoga ni kazi ya wanawake miongoni mwa Wadigo. Pakia aligundua kuwa ni aina takriban kumi tu zinazoliwa, zile ambazo wazee walifundisha kuwa zinalika, na kwamba wakusanyaji huzichuma zikiwa changa, kofia ikiwa bado imefunga (*fundula*), kwa sababu kofia zilizofunguka (*bumula*) kwa kawaida hujaa funza.

names.en: Pakia records *nimahembo*; the meaning is not explained. It shares the *nima-* beginning with *nimakoba* and *nimaziya*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *nimahembo*; maana yake haielezwi. Linashiriki mwanzo wa *nima-* na *nimakoba* na *nimaziya*.
